questions.question: A camp of soldiers has food for 200 days. After 20 days, 100 more soldiers join the camp and the food now can last for 80 days. What was the initial number of soldiers in the camp?
questions.solution:
Given:

In a soldier camp ration is available for x soldiers for 200 days

After 20 days 100 soldiers joined

Calculation:

Let the initial no. of soldiers be x.

After 20 days :

For 1 soldiers, ration will last (200 - 20) days = 180 days

For x soldiers, the ration will last {180 × (x)} days

Now, 

Number of soldiers = x + 100 

For (x + 100) soldiers, the ration will last for = (180x)/(x + 100)

For (x + 100) soldiers, the ration will last for = (180x)/(x+100)days.

Now, given Time = 80 days

(180x)/(x+100) = 80 

⇒ 80x + 8000 = 180x

⇒ 100x = 8000

Hence, x = 80

∴ Initial Number of soldiers was 80.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Calculation:

Let number of soldiers be x.

∴ Total available food = x × 200

Food consumed by x soldiers in 20 days = x × 20

Now, 100 soldiers are added to camp,

∴ New number of soldiers = (x + 100)

Now rest food is finished in 80 days by (x + 100) soldiers

∴ food consumed in 80 days = (x + 100) × 80

According to question -

⇒ 200x = 20x + 80(x + 100)

⇒ 200x = 100x + 8000

⇒ 100x = 8000

x = 80

**∴ Initial number of soldiers are 80. **

Ankit sells an article at a loss of 10 percent. If he buys it for 30 percent less price and sells it for Rs. 26 less price, then his profit will be 10 percent. What is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial loss = 10%

Profit in new scenario = 10%

Difference in selling price = Rs. 26

Reduction in cost price = 30%

**Formula Used:**

1. Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) × (1 ± Profit/Loss Percentage)

2. New Cost Price = Original Cost Price × (1 - Reduction Percentage)

3. Difference in Selling Price = Original SP - New SP

**Calculation:**

Let the original cost price be CP.

Initial Selling Price (SP) = CP × (1 - 0.10)

⇒ Initial SP = 0.9CP

New Cost Price = CP × (1 - 0.30)

⇒ New CP = 0.7CP

New Selling Price = New CP × (1 + 0.10)

⇒ New SP = 0.7CP × 1.10

⇒ New SP = 0.77CP

Difference in Selling Price = Initial SP - New SP

⇒ 0.9CP - 0.77CP = 26

⇒ 0.13CP = 26

⇒ CP = 26 / 0.13

⇒ CP = 200

**The cost price of the article is Rs. 200.**

questions.question: The ratio of milk and water in a mixture of 240 litres is 3 : 2. 40 litres of the mixture is taken out and 9 litres of milk to be added. Find the final ratio between milk and water.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of milk and water = 3 : 2

40 litre of the mixture is taken out.

Milk added in mixture = 9 litres

Total quantity of mixture = 240 litre

**Concept used:**

The ratio of milk and water to be taken out from the mixture will be in the same ratio as present in the mixture.

**Calculation:**

Let milk and water be 3x and 2x respectively in the mixture.

Milk present initially = 3 × 240/5 litres

⇒ 144 litres

Water present initially = (240 – 144) litres

⇒ 96 litres

Quantity of milk taken out from mixture = 40 × (3/5) = 24 litres

Quantity of water taken out in the mixture = 40 × (2/5) = 16 litres

New quantity of milk in the mixture = (144 - 24) =120 litres

New quantity of water in the mixture = (96 – 16) = 80 litres

Then, the new ratio will be

(120 + 9) : 80

⇒ 129 : 80

**∴ Final ratio between milk and water is 129 : 80.**

⇒ The perimeter of the square = 4 × 22 = 88 cm

⇒ r = 14 cm

questions.question: Fresh fruits contain 72% water and dry fruit contains 20% water. How much dry fruit can be obtained from 100kg of fresh fruit?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The quantity of solid pulp remains constant during drying.

Pulp in Fresh Fruit = Pulp in Dry Fruit

⇒ 28% of 100 kg = 80% of Dry Fruit

⇒ Dry Fruit = (28 × 100) ÷ 80 = 35 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 35 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Weight of fresh fruit = 100 kg

Water in fresh fruit = 72%

Water in dry fruit = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Amount of pulp = Total weight × (100 − Water %)

*Note: The weight of the solid pulp remains unchanged when water evaporates.*

 Fresh Fruit (100 kg)
 
 
 Water 72% (72 kg)
 Pulp 28% (28 kg)
 
 
• 
 
• 
 Constant Pulp Weight

 Dry Fruit (x kg)
 
 
 20%
 Pulp 80% (28 kg)
 
 Total Dry Fruit Weight = 28 kg ÷ 80% = 35 kg

**Calculations:**

⇒ Percentage of pulp in fresh fruit = 100% − 72% = 28%

⇒ Weight of pulp in 100 kg fresh fruit = 28% of 100 = 28 kg

⇒ Percentage of pulp in dry fruit = 100% − 20% = 80%

⇒ Let the total weight of the dry fruit be x kg.

⇒ Since the pulp remains the same, 80% of x = 28 kg

⇒ (80 ÷ 100) × x = 28

⇒ x = (28 × 100) ÷ 80

⇒ x = 35 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 35 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constancy in Mixtures (Evaporation)

When a solution is heated or a fresh fruit dries, only the water content evaporates. The absolute quantity of the solid component (pulp, salt, sugar) remains constant throughout the process.

Ratio Method Application

Because the pulp amount is constant, the formula translates to: Pulp % in fresh × Fresh Weight = Pulp % in dry × Dry Weight. This implies that the total weight of the fruit is inversely proportional to the percentage of its constant element.

Base Percentage Choice

When solving evaporation or mixture problems, always identify the component that is NOT changing and immediately use it as your base reference to frame a one-line equation.

questions.question: In a 1500 m race, Anil beats Bakul by 150 m and in the same race Bakul beats Charles by 75 m. By what distance does Anil beat Charles?
questions.solution:
Given:

In a 1500 m race, Anil beats Bakul by 150 m and in the same race Bakul beats Charles by 75 m.

Concept used:

Time × Speed = Distance

Calculation:

According to the question,

Anil goes 1500m while Bakul goes (1500 - 150) i.e. 1350m.

Ratio of speed of Anil and Bakul = 1500 : 1350 = 10 : 9 = 200 : 180

According to the question,

Bakul goes 1500m while Charlie goes (1500 - 75) i.e. 1425m.

Ratio of speed of Bakul and Charlie = 1500 : 1425 = 20 : 19 = 180 : 171

So, the ratio of the speeds of Anil, Bakul and Charlie = 200 : 180 : 171

Let the speeds of Anil, Bakul and Charlie be 200k, 180k and 171k m/s respectively.

Time taken by Anil to finish the race = 1500/200k = 7.5/k seconds

Now, Anil beats Charlie by = (200 - 171)k ×7.5/k = 217.5m

**∴ Anil beat Charlie by 217.5m.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

In a 1500 m race, Anil beats Bakul by 150 m

When Anil completes the race, Bakul covered (1500 - 150) = 1350 m

In a 1500 m race Charles is 75 m behind Bakul

So, in 1350 m race Charles is 75/1500 × 1350 = 67.5 m behind Bakul

So, Charles is (67.5 + 150) = 217.5 m behind from Anil in 1500 m race

∴ Anil beat Charlie by 217.5m.

questions.question: The difference between Peter and Preeti’s ages is 5 years. When they married each other 35 years ago, 4 times Peter’s age was the same as 5 times the age of Preeti’s. What is the current sum of their ages?
questions.solution:
Let Peter and Preeti's age be A and B respectively.

The difference between Peter and Preeti’s ages is 5 years,

⇒ A – B = 5

35 years ago, 4 times Peter’s age was the same as 5 times the age of Preeti’s,

⇒ 4(A – 35) = 5(B – 35)

⇒ 4A – 140 = 5B – 175

⇒ 5B – 4A = 35

Solving,

⇒ 5B – 20 – 4B = 35

⇒ B = 55

questions.question: Raj’s income is Rs. 45,000 and his expenditure is Rs. 33,000. If his income is increased by 20% and expenditure by 12%, then what will be the percentage increase in saving?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Income : Expenditure : Savings = 45000 : 33000 : 12000 = 15 : 11 : 4

Using the weighted average method: Income = Expenditure + Savings

Let the percentage increase in savings be x%.

15 × 20% = 11 × 12% + 4 × x ⇒ 300% = 132% + 4x ⇒ 4x = 168% ⇒ x = 42%

**∴ The correct answer is 42%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial Income = ₹45,000

Initial Expenditure = ₹33,000

Income is increased by 20% and Expenditure is increased by 12%.

**Formula Used:**

Savings = Income − Expenditure

Percentage Increase = (Increase in Value ÷ Original Value) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a65412a82785a82ec15c9150c672853ca11c5292282400ba4b7b06e94055e4e2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial Savings = ₹45,000 − ₹33,000 = ₹12,000

⇒ New Income = ₹45,000 + (20% of ₹45,000) = ₹45,000 + ₹9,000 = ₹54,000

⇒ New Expenditure = ₹33,000 + (12% of ₹33,000) = ₹33,000 + ₹3,960 = ₹36,960

⇒ New Savings = New Income − New Expenditure

⇒ New Savings = ₹54,000 − ₹36,960 = ₹17,040

⇒ Increase in Savings = ₹17,040 − ₹12,000 = ₹5,040

⇒ Percentage increase in savings = (5,040 ÷ 12,000) × 100

⇒ Percentage increase in savings = 42%

**∴ The correct answer is 42%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income and Expenditure Concept

Income is always the sum of Expenditure and Savings. Any absolute or percentage change in income naturally distributes across changes in both expenditure and savings.

Weighted Average (Alligation) Method

When a base quantity is divided into two parts, the net percentage change in the total is mathematically equivalent to the weighted average of the percentage changes in its individual parts: I × I% = E × E% + S × S%.

Percentage Change Formula

Percentage Change = [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100. A positive result directly indicates an increase, while a negative result indicates a decrease.

questions.question: Running at a speed of 60 km per hour, a train passed through a 1.5 km long tunnel in two minutes, What is the length of the train ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed is 60 km per hour,

Train passed through a 1.5 km long tunnel in two minutes

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the length of the train be L

According to the question,

Total distance = 1500 m + L

Speed = 60(5/18)

⇒ 50/3 m/sec

Time = 2 × 60 = 120 sec

⇒ 1500 + L = (50/3)× 120

⇒ L = 2000 - 1500

⇒ L = 500 m

**∴ The length of the train is 500 m.**

questions.question: A thief committed a crime and escaped from the spot at a speed of 12 m/h. A Security guard started chasing him 20 minutes after the thief started running and caught him in the next 20 minutes. What is the speed (in m/h) of the Security guard?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Speed × time = distance

**Calculation:**

In the 1st 20 min the thief cover distance = 4 m,

20 min in hour = 20/60 hour

Let's assume that the speed of security guard = x m/hr, where x > 12

According to the question,

⇒ (x - 12) × 20/60 = 4

⇒ x - 12 = 12

⇒ x = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24 m/h**

questions.question: If (a + b)² = 36 and ab = 8 then, find the value of (a – b)².
questions.solution:
**Given****:**

(a + b)² = 36 and ab = 8

**Formula:**

(a + b)² - (a – b)² = 4ab

**Calculation:**

(a + b)² - (a – b)² = 4ab

⇒ 36 – (a – b)² = 4ab

⇒ (a – b)² = 36 – 32

⇒ (a – b)² = 4.

__**Method 2**__

(a + b)² = 36

⇒ a² + b² + 2ab = 36

⇒ a² + b² + 2 × 8 = 36

⇒ a² + b² = 20 ---- (1)

Now, (a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab = 20 - 2 × 8 = 20 - 16 = 4.

**__Smart trick__**

Take a = 4 and b = 2 [as (a + b)² = (4 + 2)² = 6² = 36 and ab = 4 × 2 = 8]

(a – b)² = (4 – 2)² = 2² = 4.

**∴ the correct answer is 4.**

questions.question: Two circles touch each other externally at point X. PQ is a simple common tangent to both the circles touching the circles at point P and point Q. If the radii of the circles are R and r, then find PQ².
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/811c65a75818294c821d7a9a18670cb9e0a42cadb90a332024e3b4146d8c5405.png] 

We know,

Length of direct common tangent = √[d² - (R - r)²]

where d is the distance between the centers and R and r are the radii of the circles.

PQ = √[(R + r)² - (R - r)²]

⇒ PQ = √[R² + r² + 2Rr - (R² + r² - 2Rr)]

⇒ PQ = √4Rr

⇒ PQ² = 4Rr

questions.question: A sum of money at simple interest doubles in 10 years. In how many years, at the same rate, will it be tripled?
questions.solution:
Given:

Amount = 2P

Time = 10 years

Formula used:

SI = (PRT/100) 

Amount = (PRT/100) + P

Calculation:

Amount = (PRT/100) + P

2P = (PR/10) + P 

⇒ P = (PR/10) 

⇒ R = 10%

According to the question, Amount = 3P

3P = (10PT/100) + P 

⇒ 2P = (PT/10)

⇒ T = 20 years

** ∴ Time taken to triple the amount is 20 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Interest = 2P - P = P = 100% of principle

Time = 10 year

Hence, rate = Interest/Time = 100/10 = 10%

New interest = 3P - P = 2P = 200% of principle

∴ Time = Interest/Rate = 200/10 = 20 Years

questions.question: To draw a pair of tangents to a circle which are inclined to each other at an angle of 75°, it is required to draw tangents at the end points of those two radii of the circle, the angle between whom is
questions.solution:
**Concept:**

Radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of contact

Sum of all the angles of a Quadrilateral = 360° 

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cda71d0d3d248922ab696889fae73393275d48fa6415db7ccfbc2127c3b56159.png] 

PA and PB are tangents drawn from an external point P to the circle.

∠OAP = ∠OBP = 90° (Radius is perpendicular to the tangent at the point of contact)

Now, In quadrilateral OAPB,

∠APB + ∠OAP + ∠AOB + ∠OBP = 360° 

75° + 90° + ∠AOB + 90° = 360°

∠AOB = 105°

Thus, the angle between the two radii, OA and OB is 105°

questions.question: A man travels from A to B at a speed of 36 km/hr in 74 minutes and he travels a distance from B to C with a speed of 45 km/hr in 111 minutes. Find the average speed of whole journey.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A man travels from A to B at a speed of 36 km/hr in 74 minutes and he travels a distance from B to C with a speed of 45 km/hr in 111 minutes. 

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance/Total time taken

**Calculation:**

Time taken = 74 min : 111 min [given]

Ratio of Time taken = 2 : 3

Average Speed = frac{{36 times 2 + 45 times 3}}{{2 + 3}}

Average Speed = 207/5

Average Speed = 41.4 km/hr

**∴ The average speed of whole journey is 41.4 km/h**
